newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 20 to 22 bln Ffr of BTANs Thursday.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 20 to 22 bln Ffr of BTANs Thursday.

text.p: France is to offer between 20 and 22 billion francs of government notes (BTANs) at its next scheduled auction on May 15, the Treasury said on Tuesday.
The Treasury will offer the current two-year benchmark note, the 4.75 percent April 12, 1999 BTAN, and the five-year benchmark, the 4.75 percent March 12, 2002 BTAN.
The 1999 BTAN has a payment date of June 5 and the 2002 BTAN has a payment date of June 12.
